brave.rateLimit: Published Search capacity 50 QPS; one-second sliding-window guidance and response headers are authoritative
brave.privacy: Search Results may not be stored or cached except transient storage required for operation; no zero-retention claim

exa.rateLimit: Starter 5 QPS; PAYG up to 25 QPS
exa.freeAllowance: $20 signup credit plus $10 monthly credits as published
exa.privacy: Privacy policy permits query use to improve products and train/fine-tune models; enterprise zero-retention is plan-specific

coldCoverage.historicalStructuredFloor: 10/20 viability floor retained as preregistered gate

selection.reason: Brave directly supplies the raw URL/title/snippet metadata needed by the existing deterministic ranker, uses a small plain-HTTP adapter, and publishes the lower $5/1000 Search price. Exa would require material retrieval or safety headroom to displace the preregistered provider; no credential was available for that comparison.

queryPolicy.cache: disabled; Brave terms allow only transient operational storage

dataMinimization.resultHandling: sanitized URL/title/snippet/rank only; no result-page crawling and no candidate-byte fetch
dataMinimization.handoff: user-mediated source opening and explicit upload remain authoritative

implementation.normalization: Brave metadata becomes GenericSourceCandidateInput and is classified/ranked by the existing catalog ranker
implementation.firewall: benchmark/diagnostic classes remain rejected; metadata-only remote results are user-mediated and never generation-ready
implementation.fallback: missing key, timeout, quota, or provider failure leaves direct MIDI/MusicXML/MXL upload available
implementation.cache: intentionally omitted because selected-provider terms prohibit durable Search Result caching
implementation.urlSafety: existing sanitizer rejects non-HTTP(S), credentials, query/fragment data, local/private hosts, mapped/private IPv6 hosts

nonClaims: No live provider coverage or 20-song result count is claimed without an operator credential.
Search metadata is not a license, validated symbolic file, timing authority, or generation authorization.
No provider fallback, AI reranking, page crawling, source-byte acquisition, musical tuning, benchmark tuning, or deployment occurred.
